import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_back_to_back_exact():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False  # share 600-600 = 0 minutes


def test_issue_back_to_back_reversed():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(600, 660), Event(540, 600)) is False  # share 600-600 = 0 minutes


def test_issue_single_minute_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(599, 660)) is True  # share 600-599 = 1 minute


def test_issue_identical_events():
    """Identical events must still overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(540, 600)) is True  # share 600-540 = 60 minutes


def test_issue_nested_event():
    """One event fully inside another must still overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 660), Event(570, 600)) is True  # share 600-570 = 30 minutes; 570=9*60+30, 600=10*60


def test_issue_back_to_back_no_free_gap():
    """Back-to-back events share no minute so leave no gap between them."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 540, 660)  # 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 660=11*60
    assert result == []  # [540,600)+[600,660) covers [540,660) = 660-540 = 120 minutes


def test_contract_disjoint_gap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(660, 720)) is False  # gap 660-600 = 60 minutes; 720=12*60


def test_contract_partial_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(590, 650)) is True  # share 600-590 = 10 minutes; 650=10*60+50


def test_contract_free_slots_sorted():
    """free_slots returns the gaps as (start, end) tuples sorted by start."""
    events = [Event(660, 680), Event(590, 620), Event(540, 600)]  # 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 620=10*60+20, 660=11*60, 680=11*60+20
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 720) == [(620, 660), (680, 720)]  # 720=12*60; gaps 660-620=40, 720-680=40


def test_contract_free_slots_min_minutes():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(620, 660)]  # 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 620=10*60+20, 660=11*60
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 720, min_minutes=30) == [(660, 720)]  # 720=12*60; excluded gap 620-600=20 < 30, kept gap 720-660=60


def test_contract_free_slots_clipped():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    assert free_slots([Event(500, 560)], 540, 720) == [(560, 720)]  # 500=8*60+20, 560=9*60+20, 720=12*60; clipped cover 560-540=20, gap 720-560=160


def test_contract_parse_time():
    """parse_time turns HH:MM (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:30") == 570  # 9*60+30 = 570


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_time("not-a-time")


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m, 45 -> 0h 45m)."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65//60 = 1, 65%60 = 5
    assert fmt_duration(45) == "0h 45m"  # 45//60 = 0, 45%60 = 45
